_howToAdd: Add one object to 'resources' per PDF. Only fill fields you actually know. Required: id (unique, lowercase-with-dashes), title, subject (must match a subject name below), type. Optional: author, topic, year, description, chapters (list), keywords (list), file (path like 'files/calculus-notes.pdf') OR url (legitimate source), access ('Private study' | 'Public' | 'Group'), license, status, added (YYYY-MM-DD).
